palindrome:

```
Able was I ere I saw Elba
Eve, madam Adam, Eve
No lemon, no melon
Was it a car or a cat I saw?
Madam, in Eden, I'm Adam.
Step on no pets
Sir, I'm Adam
Mom
Radar
Level
Rotator

```

Each of these is a well-known palindrome.
